insights: Class Balance & Persistence Baseline: Up days account for 53.2% (711/1337) of sessions, setting the naive majority benchmark accuracy at 53.2%.

Non-Gaussian Leptokurtic Fat Tails: Daily returns show excess kurtosis of 5.13 and skewness of 0.07, indicating extreme tail events. Robust scaling is required to dampen outlier leverage on linear weights.
Momentum Mean Reversion vs Continuation: Mean RSI for Up days (55.6) is slightly higher than Down days (55.7), but extreme RSI (>70) exhibits mean-reversion pullbacks.
Moving Average Divergence: The ratio SMA_10 / SMA_50 captures intermediate trend strength. Strong positive divergences correlate with persistent multi-week bullish regimes.
Volume Confirmation: Surges in Volume_Ratio (>1.5x of 20-day SMA) correlate with higher magnitude next-day returns, confirming directional commitment.

Low Linear Correlation: Raw correlation between individual technical indicators and next-day binary direction is moderate (|r| < 0.12), highlighting the need for non-linear ensembles (Random Forest) and sequential recurrent architectures (LSTM).
